name: Quest reward: Grandma Visitor
comment: The apples quest (Help Grandma collect her apples, 5210): loot/quest-normal plus the Grandma Visitor's bag (the user, 2026-10-30). Its reward item is the client's 637115, the quest completion loot spawner named for the Grandma Visitor (script 555). Every completion gives the bag; a duplicate pays stars when opened.
